items.title: Smoothness at a point of a morphism of algebraic spaces is equivalent to lifting along small extensions there
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises smoothness at a point of a morphism of algebraic spaces by a lifting property against surjections of local rings with square-zero kernel, and shows that it suffices to test small extensions. The proof passes to an etale chart so that the point becomes an ordinary point of a scheme, applies the schemes-side lifting criterion there, and then transports the conclusion back; the restriction to small extensions follows from a standard reduction on the test algebras. Passing the pointwise lifting condition through the chart is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 5119-5160.
